facts.summary: An authorized PDS distributor may be able to view or generate operational reports through the applicable PDS management system.
report_purpose: Monitor commodity distribution and stock-related information.
Support operational record keeping and reporting.
possible_report_information: Beneficiary or customer transaction information available to the distributor.
how_to_access: Log in using the authorized distributor account.
Open the reports or reporting section provided by the PDS management system.
Select the applicable report or reporting period.
View or download the report if the system provides that functionality.
facts.access_control: Reports containing beneficiary or transaction information should only be accessible to authorized distributor users according to the permissions of the applicable system.
facts.report_accuracy: Reports should be based on the transactions and operational data recorded in the applicable PDS system.
facts.state_specific: The available reports, report fields, filters, export options and access permissions can differ between States and Union Territories.
important_notes: Do not assume that every State/UT provides the same reports.
Only authorized users should access distributor reports.
Report information depends on the data recorded in the applicable PDS system.
Do not expose beneficiary information to unauthorized persons.

faqs.question: Can a distributor generate a PDS report?
faqs.answer: An authorized distributor may be able to view or generate operational reports through the reporting section of the applicable PDS management system.

faqs.question: What information can a distributor report contain?
faqs.answer: Depending on the system, reports may contain distribution transactions, commodity-wise quantities, beneficiary transactions, stock information and period-wise operational data.

faqs.question: How can a distributor access reports?
faqs.answer: Log in using the authorized distributor account and open the reports or reporting section provided by the PDS management system.

faqs.question: Can distributor reports be downloaded?
faqs.answer: Download or export functionality depends on the features provided by the applicable PDS management system.

faqs.question: Can a distributor see customer information in reports?
faqs.answer: A report may contain beneficiary or customer information when the applicable system provides it and the distributor has the required authorization.
